nusmp.page.book_lightning.raging_lightni: Raging Lightning - the lightning armour for thirty seconds: Speed III, Strength II, and every two seconds a bolt strikes the nearest foe within eight blocks.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_drum: Raijin's Thunder Drums - for five seconds bolts strike up to three foes in the zone every half second; a quarter of the strikes paralyse (never a boss).
nusmp.page.book_lightning.lightning_surg: Lightning Surge - you dash through up to four foes within twelve blocks, one hop every two ticks, 9 damage each, and keep a stored charge for your next blow.
